injuryReport.name: Omarr Norman-Lott
injuryReport.beatComment: Norman-Lott was activated from the Chiefs' reserve/PUP list Wednesday, but he was limited in all three practices during Week 11 prep and drew the questionable tag for Sunday's game. He's in the final stages of his recovery from a torn ACL that he sustained in October of 2025, but he's not quite ready to make his return. Norman-Lott's next opportunity to make his 2026 regular-season debut is Thanksgiving Day against the Bills.

injuryReport.name: Peter Woods
injuryReport.beatComment: Woods opened Week 11 prep with back-to-back full practices before having his reps limited Friday, which prompted the Chiefs to tag him as questionable. The rookie first-rounder has not been cleared by medical staff to play Sunday, so he will miss his third consecutive game due to a neck injury. Bryson Eason and Marcus Harris will continue to operate in rotational roles on the interior defensive line behind Chris Jones and Khyiris Tonga in the absence of Woods, whose next chance to play is Thanksgiving Day against the Bills.

injuryReport.name: Garrett Nussmeier
injuryReport.beatComment: The rookie seventh-rounder has yet to appear in a regular-season game in 2026. As the emergency QB3, Nussmeier is prohibited from playing Sunday unless both Patrick Mahomes and Justin Fields leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

injuryReport.name: Ben VanSumeren
injuryReport.beatComment: VanSumeran injured his knee in the second half, and with no other fullback on the 53-man roster, the Chiefs could turn to tight end Jake Briningstool to provide additional blocking out of the backfield. VanSumeran's status over the coming days will be worth monitoring, given that the Chiefs are operating on a short week and play against the Bills on Thanksgiving Day.

injuryReport.name: Noah Gray
injuryReport.beatComment: Gray's injury status was announced late in the game after Kansas City had already built an insurmountable lead, so it would be a surprise if the tight end returns to the contest. The bigger picture is the Chiefs' Thanksgiving matchup against Buffalo -- if Gray is dealing with a more-than-minor issue, his availability for that game could be in peril. Gray finished Sunday's matchup with three catches for 21 yards on five targets.

irReserve.name: Jared Wiley
irReserve.beatComment: Wiley was carted to the locker room in the first quarter of the Chiefs' Week 10 win over the Falcons with an ankle injury. The tight end will now be on IR as he nurses his fractured ankle until at least the latter part of the regular season. Travis Kelce, Noah Gray and Jake Briningstool are now the only tight ends on the Chiefs' active roster.

coachingMatchup.headline: Joe Brady & DC Jim Leonhard vs. HC Andy Reid & DC Steve Spagnuolo (Highmark Stadium)
coachingMatchup.summary: Week 12 two-sided coordinator chess match pitting Buffalo Bills's staff (Joe Brady, OC Pete Carmichael Jr., DC Jim Leonhard) against Kansas City Chiefs (8-2)—testing both Buffalo's offensive efficiency and its defensive pass-rush and coverage discipline.
bullets: Pass-Game Efficiency & Coverage Shell Delta: Joe Brady and OC Pete Carmichael Jr. look to stress Kansas City Chiefs's single-high vs. two-high rotations with pre-snap motion, spacing, and play-action timing, while Kansas City Chiefs's defensive front and coverage disguises aim to compress intermediate throwing windows.

Trench Run-Fit & Two-Way Leverage: DC Jim Leonhard balances pass-rush pressure with two-high/split-safety discipline on early downs, while Kansas City Chiefs's offense tests Buffalo's edge containment, third-down execution, and red-zone stops.
